messages:
tanya: Quick heads-up: On‑prem/Private edge release 1.3 is GA today. Highlights: offline installer images, stricter default network policy (deny-by-default), enhanced audit-forwarding to customer SIEMs, and the compliance-pack templating for FedRAMP-ready customers. Docs and PS sign-up in the rollout doc.
omar: Nice. Any admin API changes?
tanya: Admin API adds two flags: network_mode (default 'strict') and audit_forwarder_url. Example update: curl -X PATCH https://private.redwood/api/v1/projects/42 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <tok>' -d '{"network_mode":"strict","audit_forwarder_url":"https://siem.acme/ingest"}'
raju: Installers: we published offline tarballs for air-gapped installs plus checksum and GPG sigs. See internal storage link. Installer size ~420MB.
security: Security note: default deny network policy will block p2p debug endpoints; PS will need to open ssh-control and metrics ports during onboarding. We documented minimal port list in the KB.
gerry: Compliance: added a FedRAMP checklist and a templated system security plan (SSP) skeleton. Legal please review customer-facing wording; we reference retained audit logs for 90 days by default.
tanya: Action items: 1) CSM outreach (csm-bot) 1) PS booking (csm-bot) 2) Legal sign-off on SSP wording (gerry + legal) 3) Ops monitor upgrade telemetry for 48h.
csm-bot: PS-bot: Onboarding slots: Mon 11:00-13:00, Tue 16:00-18:00. Use /book-ps <customer>.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: onprem-1.3 -> prod pools completed at 1782306600 :white_check_mark:
tanya: We'll run a short sync tomorrow 08:30 PT to triage any post-upgrade issues. Tag me if you see noisy logs or blocked tenants. Thanks team!
